none: PAS FindID 1016313: Roman coin: radiate of Gallienus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Gallienus (260-268), reverse legend may suggest of joint reign (253-260). Obverse description: radiate bust right, pelloidal beard. Obverse inscription: [--]LIENVS AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left with vertical spear. Reverse inscription: [--]AVGVSTI. Diameter: 12.2mm, Weight: 2.64gms, die axis: 6
